verses.1: I have come to you, brothers, not with words of wisdom or eloquence, but to tell you about God’s suffering.
verses.2: For surely, none of you will recognize anything as true if it isn’t Jesus Christ, who was crucified.
verses.3: I became like this because of weakness, fear, and much anxiety.
verses.4: And my words and my preaching are not based on wisdom, but rather on the power and strength of the Spirit.
verses.5: So that your faith may not be based on human wisdom, but rather on the power of God.
verses.6: We speak of wisdom in those who are perfect. But wisdom is not something that belongs to this age, nor to those who rule over it.
verses.7: But we will speak of God’s wisdom in this mystery, that wisdom which has been hidden from us since the beginning of time. It is a wisdom that God revealed for our benefit.
verses.8: Who among the leaders of this era could have known this? For if they had known, they would surely not have crowned the Lord of Glory king.
verses.9: But as it is written: He did not see with his eyes, nor hear with his ears, nor enter into a man’s heart, what God has prepared for those who love Him.
verses.10: For the God revealed things to us through His Spirit. For the Spirit indeed knows everything, even the depths of God’s being.
verses.11: For who could know what belongs to a human being, unless it is the spirit that resides within him? Similarly, no one could know what belongs to God, unless it is the spirit that resides within Him.
verses.12: We, however, do not take the breath of this world; rather, we take the breath that comes from God. This is so that we may know what has been given to us by God.
verses.13: And we do not speak in terms of human wisdom, but rather in terms of the spirit. We compare spiritual things based on their spiritual nature.
verses.14: A human being, however, cannot accept the spirit of God. For it is愚蠢 of him to do so. He cannot understand that he is being judged spiritually.
verses.15: But the spiritual one examines everything; he himself is not examined by anyone.
verses.16: Who else knows the mind of the Lord, who will make Him suffer? But we do know the mind of Christ.
